title: Anthony Richardson sees ‘blessing in disguise’ as he waits for possible Colts trade

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Anthony Richardson sees ‘blessing in disguise’ as he waits for possible Colts trade
sources.description: There doesn’t appear to be much of a trade market for Richardson, who has made just 15 starts since he was the No. 4 pick in the 2023 draft.
